review_scope: Skeleton videos generated for63 command samples across20 tasks (3 per class, turn6), plus start/middle/end contact sheets inspected for all20; dense playback not claimed. Full200 rollouts quantified. No skinned mesh, contact labels or naturalness benchmark.
findings: Turn moves while rotating, but requested speed remains inaccurate: MAE0.22215m/s at selected7700. Visible poses/paths suggest foot sliding; no claim of ground-truth contact detection.
Sidestep displacement follows requests well (MAE0.02260m), but feet and root follow largely parallel paths; the step-and-plant pattern is weak in reviewed frames.
Walk/back_walk/jog have median fractions1.0 with BOTH ankle horizontal speeds above0.1m/s. This is a descriptive sliding warning, not a contact-classification metric.
March has median net root translation1.430m over fixed validation clips; it is not consistently stationary marching. Only one independent validation caption source exists for this class.

Squat/bow/clap have recognizable gross pose changes in reviewed frames. Point high command remains undershot. Arm-circle/stretch scalar amplitude alone does not certify a complete circular/stretch sequence.
Upper-body tasks also drift: median root net displacement twist0.561m, stretch0.421m, raise_hand0.374m. No extra root conditions or corrective transforms were added.
